\section[(dialogue)]{Places in town and at home — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R109-first-pass-places-in-town-and-at-home}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a skill and an art.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a lift, a corridor, a public square, an airport, a port
  \item a neighbourhood, an alley, a building, a bathroom, a balcony
  \item a roof, stairs, a ceiling, behind, between
  \item beside, left, the middle, a corner, north
  \item south, east, west, a place, an address
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A lift? (\textbf{\ar{مصعد}}, \emph{miṣʿad}.) A corridor? (\textbf{\ar{ممر}}, \emph{mamarr}.) A public square? (\textbf{\ar{ميدان}}, \emph{maydān}.) An airport? (\textbf{\ar{مطار}}, \emph{maṭār}.) A port? (\textbf{\ar{ميناء}}, \emph{mīnāʾ}.) A neighbourhood? (\textbf{\ar{حي}}, \emph{ḥayy}.) An alley? (\textbf{\ar{زقاق}}, \emph{zuqāq}.) A building? (\textbf{\ar{مبنى}}, \emph{mabnā}.) A bathroom? (\textbf{\ar{حمام}}, \emph{ḥammām}.) A balcony? (\textbf{\ar{شرفة}}, \emph{shurfa}.) A roof? (\textbf{\ar{سطح}}, \emph{saṭḥ}.) Stairs? (\textbf{\ar{درج}}, \emph{daraj}.) A ceiling? (\textbf{\ar{سقف}}, \emph{saqf}.) Behind? (\textbf{\ar{خلف}}, \emph{khalfa}.) Between? (\textbf{\ar{بين}}, \emph{bayna}.) Beside? (\textbf{\ar{بجانب}}, \emph{bi-jānib}.) Left? (\textbf{\ar{يسار}}, \emph{yasār}.) The middle? (\textbf{\ar{وسط}}, \emph{wasaṭ}.) A corner? (\textbf{\ar{زاوية}}, \emph{zāwiya}.) North? (\textbf{\ar{شمال}}, \emph{shamāl}.) South? (\textbf{\ar{جنوب}}, \emph{janūb}.) East? (\textbf{\ar{شرق}}, \emph{sharq}.) West? (\textbf{\ar{غرب}}, \emph{gharb}.) A place? (\textbf{\ar{مكان}}, \emph{makān}.) An address? (\textbf{\ar{عنوان}}, \emph{ʿunwān}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Rooms, having and being able — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R109-second-pass-rooms-having-and-being-able}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an entrance and an exit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an entrance, an exit, straight ahead, around, at
  \item a possibility, authority, success, mastery, ability
  \item competence, a certificate, ownership, to be able to, to be able to
  \item it is possible, with, strength, a right, an owner
  \item wealth, experience, a habit, a skill, an art
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An entrance? (\textbf{\ar{مدخل}}, \emph{madkhal}.) An exit? (\textbf{\ar{مخرج}}, \emph{makhraj}.) Straight ahead? (\textbf{\ar{مستقيم}}, \emph{mustaqīm}.) Around? (\textbf{\ar{حول}}, \emph{ḥawla}.) At? (\textbf{\ar{عند}}, \emph{ʿinda}.) A possibility? (\textbf{\ar{إمكانية}}, \emph{imkāniyya}.) Authority? (\textbf{\ar{سلطة}}, \emph{sulṭa}.) Success? (\textbf{\ar{نجاح}}, \emph{najāḥ}.) Mastery? (\textbf{\ar{إتقان}}, \emph{itqān}.) Ability? (\textbf{\ar{قدرة}}, \emph{qudra}.) Competence? (\textbf{\ar{كفاءة}}, \emph{kafāʾa}.) A certificate? (\textbf{\ar{شهادة}}, \emph{shahāda}.) Ownership? (\textbf{\ar{ملكية}}, \emph{milkiyya}.) To be able to? (\textbf{\ar{استطاع}}, \emph{istaṭāʿa}.) To be able to? (\textbf{\ar{قدر}}, \emph{qadara}.) It is possible? (\textbf{\ar{يمكن}}, \emph{yumkin}.) With? (\textbf{\ar{لدى}}, \emph{ladā}.) Strength? (\textbf{\ar{قوة}}, \emph{quwwa}.) A right? (\textbf{\ar{حق}}, \emph{ḥaqq}.) An owner? (\textbf{\ar{مالك}}, \emph{mālik}.) Wealth? (\textbf{\ar{ثروة}}, \emph{tharwa}.) Experience? (\textbf{\ar{خبرة}}, \emph{khibra}.) A habit? (\textbf{\ar{عادة}}, \emph{ʿāda}.) A skill? (\textbf{\ar{مهارة}}, \emph{mahāra}.) An art? (\textbf{\ar{فن}}, \emph{fann}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
